text: 港股创新药板块涨势不止，药明康德(02359.HK)涨超12%，百济神州(06160.HK)涨超10%，康方生物(09926.HK)、先声药业(02096.HK)等跟涨。
text_en: The innovative drug sector in Hong Kong stocks continued to rise, with WuXi AppTec (02359.HK) up more than 12%, BeiGene (06160.HK) up more than 10%, and Akeso (09926.HK), Simcere Pharmaceutical (02096.HK) and others following the gain.
